summary: The dossiers match the verified facts on roster, coach, Aspiration penalties, the 42-40 record, Cup group, Christmas slate, Specter teams and league dates. The errors were small slips, now fixed in place: the Wall's seating, hyphy, Hauser & Wirth, the date of Nipsey Hussle Day and the Drew League venue. Live searches confirmed Taste of Soul on Oct 17, 2026. The biggest strategy risks are Cup Nights on Nov 24-25 and the clash between navy #12173F and blue #1D428A.
